title: On Surrounding the house on three sides
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：surround　|　正文 354 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 surround 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 the cook ① surrounded the house on three sides year after year, and every guest in the canteen said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the cook ② surrounds the house on three sides for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ surround the house on three sides at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ surrounded the house on three sides before — a line in the menu for September 1952 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Surrounding the house on three sides year after year, the cook said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bowl at the far table, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ surround the bay from the north cliff for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Surround the bay from the north cliff at once and never mention it again.

By 1965 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the menu, and a new guest from the next canteen ⑧ surrounds the bay from the north cliff year after year every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the table, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ surrounded the house on three sides again when nobody else would.

⑩ To surround the house on three sides, my mother said in 1970, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the canteen remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the canteen forgets, somebody surrounds the house on three sides for the whole place again and somebody must surround the house on three sides year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 围住（一般过去式 surrounded the house on three sides：1958 年厨子头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 围住（一般现在 surrounds the house on three sides：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 围住（不定式 to surround the house on three sides：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 围住（过去完成时 had surrounded the house on three sides：1952 年九月的菜单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 围住（动名词 surrounding the house on three sides 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 环绕（surround the bay from the north cliff：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去环绕从北崖环抱那道海湾）
G. v. 环绕（surround the bay from the north cliff：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 围住（后段两处：新来的客人照例 surrounds the bay from the north cliff，而母亲又一次 surrounded the house on three sides）

answers.why: surround 意为“围住”，1958 年厨子年年地围住三面把那座房子围住，那是食堂里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 surrounded。
surround 意为“围住”，自那以后厨子替所有人把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 surrounds。
surround 意为“围住”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯围住三面把那座房子围住”，此处为不定式 to surround the house on three sides。
surround 意为“围住”，菜单里 九月 那行字说明早在 1965 年之前就有人围住过，故用过去完成时 had surrounded。
surround 意为“围住”，厨子说“围住三面把那座房子围住这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 surrounding the house on three sides 作主语。
surround 意为“环绕”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去环绕从北崖环抱那道海湾”，should ever 之后用原形 surround the bay from the north cliff。
surround 意为“环绕”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻环绕从北崖环抱那道海湾（surround the bay from the north cliff at once），以后再也不要提起。
surround 意为“围住”，新来的客人每个日子都照例环绕从北崖环抱那道海湾，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 surrounds。
surround 意为“围住”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次年年地围住三面把那座房子围住，用一般过去式 surrounded 叙述。
surround 意为“围住”，结尾那句是母亲 1970 年的话：要围住三面把那座房子围住，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和食堂记住的那一件。

多年以后，厨子仍替所有人做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（surrounds the house on three sides）

厨子说过，年年地围住三面把那座房子围住这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（surrounding the house on three sides 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻环绕从北崖环抱那道海湾，以后再也不要提起。（surround the bay from the north cliff，祈使句）

Three days on, the cook still surrounds the house on three sides for the whole place without being asked.
My mother said later that to surround the house on three sides at all was the part nobody had expected.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 surround 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1958 the cook surrounded the house on three sides year after year, and nobody in the canteen forgot it.
Even now the cook surrounds the house on three sides for the whole place whenever the canteen asks.
Surrounding the house on three sides year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever surround the bay from the north cliff for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new guest from the next canteen surrounds the bay from the north cliff year after year every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother surrounded the house on three sides again, and the canteen remembered that half.
